normality_definition:
Two transparent push-wire splicing connectors with orange lever clamps, placed horizontally on a metal mesh background. A single cable connects the two connectors.

CONNECTORS:
- Exactly two connectors are present, one on the left and one on the right.
- Both connectors are the same type: they have the same number of wire-entry slots and the same overall size and height.
- Connectors are transparent with orange lever clamps visible through the housing.

CABLE:
- Exactly one cable runs between the two connectors.
- The cable is yellow in color.
- The cable is undamaged and continuous — no cuts, breaks, or exposed wire visible anywhere along its length.
- The cable enters both connectors at the same relative slot position (symmetric entry on both sides).

LAYOUT:
- The two connectors are arranged symmetrically on either side of the cable, appearing as approximate mirror images of each other.
- Neither connector is visibly taller, wider, or larger than the other.
